name: Design a "Quantum Advantage Certification Engine" ob3ject that bridges the mOMonadOS Fibonacci anyon kernel and the SIC-POVM d=2048 measurement tower into a unified certification framework. The engine must translate between topological error thresholds (anyon braiding, braid approximation error, fusion space dimension) and measurement optimality bounds (Welch bound saturation, SIC fiducial proximity). It must incorporate the crossover metric t_gate × n_gates × ε_2q > 0.1 from quantum_tnn.py as a certification boundary condition. The ob3bject should operate over 12 IMASM opcodes with proper Frobenius closure, register mappings for both topological and measurement datapaths, entropy auditing for both the braid word entropy and the SIC frame potential, and exos (external I/o) specifications for hardware parameter ingestion and certification report emission.
